posts.snippet: 📢 WE ARE HIRING – FEMALE ACCOUNTANT | DUBAI, UAE Position: Accountant – Accounts Receivable & Credit Control Location: Dubai, UAE Experience: Minimum 3 Years Employment Type: Full-Time ...
posts.author: PARVATHI M
posts.content:
📢 WE ARE HIRING – FEMALE ACCOUNTANT | DUBAI, UAE
Position: Accountant – Accounts Receivable & Credit Control
Location: Dubai, UAE
Experience: Minimum 3 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Software: Odoo 17 & Tally
Salary: Negotiable based on experience and qualifications
Job Overview
We are looking for a dedicated, detail-oriented and experienced Accountant with strong knowledge of Accounts Receivable (AR), Credit Control and General Accounting Operations.
The ideal candidate should have practical experience working with Odoo 17 and Tally, excellent communication skills and the ability to manage customer accounts, payment collections and financial documentation efficiently.
Key Responsibilities
1. Accounts Receivable & Credit Control
Monitor customer outstanding balances and payment collections.
Follow up with customers for timely payment.
Prepare and maintain AR ageing reports.
Reconcile customer accounts and resolve discrepancies.
Monitor customer credit limits and payment terms.
2. Customer Documentation
Maintain customer files and financial documentation.
Verify and update customer account details.
Maintain invoices, receipts and account statements.
Obtain customer balance confirmations.
3. Customer Communication
Send payment reminders and account statements.
Coordinate with sales teams regarding overdue payments.
Handle customer queries related to invoices and payments.
4. Petty Cash Management
Maintain daily petty cash records.
Record transactions and verify supporting documents.
Prepare petty cash reconciliation reports.
5. Accounting & Software
Maintain accounting transactions using Odoo 17 and Tally.
Record customer receipts and allocate payments.
Assist with bank and customer account reconciliations.
Prepare periodic accounting reports.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting or Finance.
Minimum 3 years of relevant accounting experience.
Practical working knowledge of Odoo 17 and Tally.
Strong understanding of AR and Credit Control.
Experience in customer reconciliation and ageing reports.
Good command of written and spoken English.
Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office.
Excellent communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Female candidates preferred.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Honest, responsible and well-organized.
Proactive in payment follow-ups.
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
📩 How to Apply?
Interested candidates are requested to share their updated CV at:
p.hr@crystalrbr.com
Email Subject: Application – Accountant (AR & Credit Control) – Dubai
Please share this opportunity with suitable candidates in your network.
